'''Avinoam Arelis''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] stationed at the [[new Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Arelis, along with fellow knight [[Jaden Korr]] were assisting Jedi [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and Jedi [[Tekli]] smuggle the four Jedi who were undergoing treatment for [[Force psychosis]], through a [[Jedi Temple/Legends|lower level hangar]] in the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]]. Looking out onto the [[Krabbis Inn]], the hangar was being watched by a gang of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to keep an eye on the Jedi.

When the Mandalorians opened fire on the hangar, Arelis and Korr aided the Solos in defending the hangar, while the other Knights helped move Jedi [[Bazel Warv]], [[Natua Wan]], [[Seff Hellin]], and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] into [[FloatVan]]s for transportation to the [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Shedu Maad]]. When the fight ended, Arelis and Korr stayed behind to cover up the mess the now deceased warriors had made while the other Jedi escaped.

In [[44 ABY]], Arelis was sent with fellow Jedi Knight [[Sothais Saar]] to [[Blaudu Sextus]] by the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] to help mediate the [[Octusi]] [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]]. However, upon their arrival in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Arari]], they found that [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under the command of [[Belok Rhal]] were slaughtering the Octusi, and intervened. During the engagement, Arelis and Saar breached a building where [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] and her crew had been hiding and reporting the events live on the news. While Arelis and Saar were too late to save Vaandt from being killed by Rhal, they were able to apprehend her murderer.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
